claimed_coverage: Tests verify the core bug fix (setbits = 0 initialization in stm32_adc.c), existence and structure of new driver files (ADC, GPIO, PWM, QEncoder, USB), pysim_cm7 configuration settings, Makefile updates, and board header definitions for the Nucleo-H745ZI board support package.
fix_patch_grounding: The fix.patch adds driver implementations for ADC, GPIO, PWM, QEncoder, and USB subsystems, plus a critical bug fix initializing setbits = 0 in arch/arm/src/stm32h7/stm32_adc.c to prevent undefined behavior during ADC clock configuration.
issue_context_used: The issue.md describes the need for complete hardware abstraction for Nucleo-H745ZI board including ADC, GPIO, PWM, QEncoder, and USB drivers, with emphasis on proper initialization to prevent undefined behavior.
notes: Hidden tests verify the fix by inspecting /workspace for the core bug fix (setbits = 0 initialization), new driver files (ADC, GPIO, PWM, QEncoder, USB), pysim_cm7 configuration, Makefile updates, and board header definitions. Tests pass when fix.patch is applied to /workspace and fail without the fix. Tests are deterministic and do not require actual hardware. The test suite uses pytest framework which is already installed in the runtime environment.
